# TurfMate Release Skill

Prepare TurfMate for releases.

## Release checklist

### Code

* implementation complete
* code review complete

### Testing

* unit tests pass
* integration tests pass
* relevant E2E tests pass

### Database

* migrations included
* migration tested
* rollback considered

### Documentation

* current implementation updated
* API updated
* database documentation updated
* changelog updated

### Environment

* environment variables documented
* secrets verified

### Deployment

* Docker/build succeeds
* application starts
* health checks pass

## Release report

Provide:

Version
Changes
Database changes
API changes
Tests
E2E
Known issues
Deployment requirements
Rollback considerations
